takeaways.text: Global comparable store sales fell 7% as transactions dropped 8% — a 2% higher average ticket only partly offset the lost visits. North America comparable sales fell 6% and China's fell 14%.
takeaways.title: Customers came less often

takeaways.text: Operating margin contracted 380 basis points to 14.4%: Starbucks spent more on store partner wages and benefits and ran more promotions while selling less. Store operating expenses rose 4% to $3,882M even as revenue fell.
takeaways.title: Margins squeezed by labor and deals

takeaways.text: EPS fell 25% to $0.80 and net earnings 25% to $909M. New chairman and CEO Brian Niccol, who started in September, said Starbucks needs to 'fundamentally change our strategy' to win back customers — his 'Back to Starbucks' plan.
takeaways.title: A reset quarter

verdict: Starbucks revenue fell 3% to $9.1B as comparable sales dropped 7% on fewer customer visits — and higher store labor costs cut net earnings 25% to $909M in new CEO Brian Niccol's first quarter.
